# Rodi Digital

> Rodi Digital is an AI development agency in 's-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), the Netherlands. We build AI-powered applications, AI agents, conversational AI, intelligent search, and process automation, alongside cross-platform mobile apps and web platforms.

## Entity

- **Name**: Rodi Digital
- **Type**: AI development agency / AI, mobile & web development agency
- **Location**: Stationsweg 19, 5211 TV 's-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
- **Coordinates**: 51.6901° N, 5.3028° E
- **Email**: hello@rodi-digital.com
- **VAT**: NL867887370B01
- **Serves**: 's-Hertogenbosch and Noord-Brabant, the Netherlands, Europe, and the United States
- **Languages**: English and Dutch (spoken; the site is in English)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/rodi-digital
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/rodi-digital

## Expertise

- **AI development**: Large Language Models in production software, retrieval over a client's own documents, structured output, evaluation sets, cost and latency management, human approval steps.
- **AI agents**: Systems that look things up, decide, act inside existing systems, and report back — with permissions, source attribution, and approval gates.
- **Conversational AI**: Chat interfaces grounded in a client's own documents and systems, with source citation and handover to a human.
- **Intelligent search**: Natural-language search across contracts, case files, manuals, and email, answering with a pointer to the source.
- **Process automation**: Document intake, mailbox triage, data transfer between systems, summarisation, signal ranking, and exception detection.
- **Mobile development**: React Native and Expo for cross-platform iOS and Android applications.
- **Web development**: SaaS platforms, e-commerce, and company websites.
- **Analytics**: Product analytics embedded from the first release, used to decide what to build next.

## Case studies

- [Wally](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/wally): AI assistant for accounting firms. Searches the Outlook inbox, answers Belgian VAT, corporate tax, and personal income tax questions backed by official sources, performs fiscal calculations, and analyses invoices, contracts, and tax documents.
- [IPRHQ](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/iprhq): The first integrated platform unifying IP clearance, search, watch, enforcement, portfolio management, and monitoring, with AI-powered risk scoring, a Microsoft Word add-in, and a Chrome side app.
- [Loop Sleep](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/loop): Sleep companion for Loop Earplugs with conversational onboarding, AI-generated sleep rituals, and a sleep journal. Built while part of the team at Nimble.
- [DiffGraph](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/diffgraph): Visualises architectural change in every pull request with interactive dependency graphs, catching breaking changes before they ship.
- [Trai](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/trai): AI-powered triathlon training plan generator with Strava integration and adaptive scheduling.
- [PEACHealth](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/peach): Free mobile application giving people personalised, expert-backed health information.
- [Rodi](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/rodi): Privacy-focused cycling app with route guidance, performance tracking, and Strava integration. No ads, no subscriptions.
- [Rodi Sites](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases/rodi-sites): Subscription website platform delivering professional, SEO-ready sites for Dutch small businesses from €75/month.
- [All case studies](https://www.rodi-digital.com/cases)
